title: C23 kotel
prompt: Close-up of a huge cracked iron cauldron that has exploded, thick glowing bright orange chaos goo overflows and splashes everywhere, and out of the molten goo rise three different misshapen half-formed creatures still melting and changing shape - one with too many eyes, one with a bat wing and a claw, one with a long tentacle and a horn - crackling orange lightning, orange smoke and sparks. No people, no hands. Background: hot red-orange glow with drifting embers. Palette: crimson, burnt orange, bright yellow-orange, black, no teal. No text.
